one_line: Kakatiya monarch of Warangal who expanded his realm across coastal Andhra through inscription-backed alliances, campaigns, and monumental projects.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, tall and athletic, with a seasoned warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown Deccan complexion, sharp straight nose, neatly trimmed mustache, short beard along the jawline, intense almond-shaped eyes, and a calm, commanding expression that softens into a slight confident smile
appearance.hair: thick black hair, shoulder-length, loosely tied at the back with a narrow red cloth band; on the head a simple golden Kakatiya-style crown band with a central leaf-shaped front plate and small side studs, not overly tall
appearance.costume: era-accurate Kakatiya royal warrior attire: a rich deep-red silk angavastra draped over the left shoulder and across the chest, worn above a fitted, sleeved beige cotton upper garment; below, a golden-ochre dhoti with faint block-printed geometric borders in maroon and dark green, pleated in front and tied securely at the waist, extending to the ankles; simple leather sandals; jewellery includes a pair of medium-sized round gold earrings, a short gold necklace of flat discs, two slim gold armlets on each upper arm with subtle scrollwork, and several thin bangles on the right wrist; no heavy armor, but a quilted, light-brown cloth vambrace on the left forearm hinting at battlefield readiness
appearance.signature: a long, slightly curved steel sword with a plain iron cross-guard and a dark wooden hilt wrapped in red cloth, carried sheathed in a brown leather scabbard hanging from a simple belt at his left hip, right hand resting on the pommel in a poised, decisive manner

ref_desc: Ganapati Deva is a mid-40s, medium-brown Kakatiya king with shoulder-length tied black hair, a simple golden crown band, deep-red angavastra, beige upper garment, golden-ochre dhoti, light jewellery, and a curved sword in a brown scabbard, in deep red and ochre tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Ganapati Deva as a dignified 13th-century Kakatiya monarch: mid-40s, tall and athletic, with a medium-brown Deccan complexion, oval face, sharp straight nose, neatly trimmed mustache and short jawline beard, and intense almond-shaped eyes in a calm, commanding expression. His thick black hair is shoulder-length, loosely tied at the back with a narrow red cloth band, and he wears a simple golden crown band with a central leaf-shaped front plate and small side studs. Dress him in era-accurate royal warrior clothing: a rich deep-red silk angavastra draped over the left shoulder and across the chest, over a fitted, sleeved beige cotton upper garment; a golden-ochre dhoti with faint maroon and dark green geometric borders, pleated in front, tied at the waist, and reaching the ankles; simple brown leather sandals. Add medium-sized round gold earrings, a short gold disc necklace, slim gold armlets on each upper arm, and a few thin bangles on the right wrist, plus a quilted light-brown cloth vambrace on the left forearm. His signature weapon is a long, slightly curved steel sword with a plain iron cross-guard and a dark wooden hilt wrapped in red cloth, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip, with his right hand resting on the pommel. Use a palette dominated by deep red, golden ochre, beige, dark green, and brown, and pose him upright and regal, ready for both courtly negotiation and campaign, clearly showing face, hair, full costume, and sword from head to toe.
